benchmark_cases.acceptance_gate: At least one high-quality, mostly parseable CV sample exists before score bucket agreement is claimed.
Scanned/image-only files must be represented before empty-text precision or recall is claimed.
Text-order failure examples must be reviewed before treating multi-column PDFs as low risk.
DOCX parser support must be explicit; unsupported DOCX cannot be silently scored high.
Table-heavy fixtures must include successful and failed parses to avoid over-penalizing all tables.
Short but valid entry-level CVs must be distinguished from empty/under-informative parses.
Long-CV penalty must be based on reviewer evidence, not page count alone.

blocked_until_later_phases: Production ATS score semantics require Phase 10 calibration evidence.
Classifier training is blocked until benchmark labels exist with enough examples per issue family.
Release claims are blocked until empty-text and critical parse failures receive manual review.

failure_case_review_workflow: Queue every empty-text, scanned/image-only, unsupported-file, and parser-error case for manual review.
For each false negative issue, record missing source signal, parser limitation, and taxonomy update need.
For each false positive issue, record threshold problem, layout exception, or reviewer ambiguity.
Publish aggregate review findings without raw contact values or full CV text.
Block promotion if critical parse failures are not reviewed or if score-bucket errors cluster in one required case family.
evaluation_policy.label_source: manual reviewer labels on locked benchmark manifest; weak parser labels may bootstrap only after review

promotion_policy.current_decision: GO for rule design and benchmark policy; NO-GO for production ATS scoring claim until benchmark labels and calibration exist
promotion_policy.phase10_dependency: Production score semantics and thresholds require calibration diagnostics before release claims.

score_bands.product_meaning_ats: CV has serious parseability, structure, contact/date, metric, or formatting issues that can block reliable screening.
CV is mostly parseable but has issues that can reduce ranking or hide important evidence.
CV is parseable, structured, contact/date evidence is detectable, and formatting risk is low.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store aggregate extraction counts and parser status only.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Manual review checks whether readable CV content was lost during parsing.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Reduce parseability component; cap total score when text coverage is too low.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store section labels and counts, not full raw section text in labels.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Reviewer confirms whether section content exists even when heading is nonstandard.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Score by required section coverage; missing experience or skills is stronger than missing optional sections.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store booleans only; never store raw contact values in training labels or reports.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Reviewer checks detection false negatives on anonymized display, not persisted PII.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Missing all contact evidence is high severity; missing optional portfolio/profile link is role-dependent and lower severity.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store normalized date-pattern evidence and consistency flags only.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Locale-specific date formats must be reviewed before marking dates missing.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Score by parseable date coverage for experience and education entries.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store aggregate counts and anonymized snippets only when needed for audit.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Reviewer distinguishes legitimate qualitative CVs from generic responsibility lists.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Reward quantified achievements; do not invent metrics when absent.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store layout metrics and parser diagnostics, not screenshots unless consented fixtures exist.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Reviewer confirms whether layout actually harms ATS text order or section detection.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Subtract bounded formatting penalties; low-risk layout should not be penalized.

issue_taxonomy.privacy_rule: Store parser status and counts only.
issue_taxonomy.review_rule: Every empty parse must enter failure-case review before release metrics are accepted.
issue_taxonomy.score_effect: Hard cap total score at low band until OCR/parser recovery is proven.

model_owned_fields.grounding_rule: Derived only from ATS component evidence and Phase 10 calibration; never from job-fit score, recommendation rank, or wrapper copy.
Issue keys must come from the Phase 7 taxonomy and include severity plus source_evidence_keys without raw PII.

item_shape.family: parseable_text | section_completeness | contact_detection | date_detection | metric_evidence | excessive_formatting_risk | empty_parse_risk

model_owned_fields.grounding_rule: Debug/audit field for model card and calibration; not required in public API response.
Notes describe data quality, parser uncertainty, missing layout metrics, or manual-review requirement.

public_api_mapping.atsFriendliness.score: core.score rounded/clipped to integer 0-100 after Phase 10 calibration
public_api_mapping.atsFriendliness.summary: API wrapper renders concise product copy from detectedIssues, score band, and confidenceNotes

separation_policy.ats_vs_jobfit: ATS score uses CV quality and parser/layout evidence only; job-fit score uses candidate/job alignment evidence only.
separation_policy.privacy_boundary: Detected issues can mention missing contact evidence but must not expose raw email, phone, or URL values.
separation_policy.summary_boundary: Core emits issue signals; wrapper writes public summary without adding unsupported claims.

confidence_notes: unknown_layout_metrics lowers confidence but does not create a false issue
manual_review_required for empty parses, parser errors, or conflicting reviewer labels
score semantics remain draft until Phase 10 calibration
rule_based_baseline.detected_issue_rule: Emit issue keys whose component evidence crosses documented thresholds; include severity and source_evidence keys, not raw PII.
rule_based_baseline.score_formula: round(100 * sum(component_score[component] * weight[component])) after applying hard caps

inherited_blockers: Phase 10 must calibrate score bands before production score semantics are finalized.
Phase 10 must calibrate score meanings after feature and label distributions are stable.
Phase 3 must define normalization rules before labels are generated.
Phase 4 must generate balanced pairs using these normalization policies and publish feature-quality metrics.
Phase 4 must generate balanced pairs with leakage-safe splits before baseline evaluation.
Phase 5 must compare baselines using these normalized features before complex model training.
Phase 5 must run this baseline catalog before model training.
Phase 7 must build controlled ATS benchmark samples before production ATS claims.
Phase 7 must evaluate ATS text extraction quality before production ATS claims.
